search.navy_drawn_rule: Primal search boundary at Delta_max = 6. Above c = 1.1: the zero level of the interpolated survey score field, survey_contours, as (c-1, gap) pairs. Empirical search results, not exclusions.

refinement.rule: PCHIP through the fine-grid crossings of the admission threshold, in log10(c-1) for c-1 <= 0.01 and linear in c-1 from 0.01 to 0.1. Empirical search results, not exclusions.

s1_L20.source: Spin-1 window [1, 1 + W] at code Lambda = 20 (paper Lambda = 19), parity-pair counting (the bracket, in primaries, must hold no even integer); one point per charge. 29 of the 44 points come from an exact-window re-bisection at the window W stored here: continuous-window SDP (window constraint imposed on the whole window), functional certificate at relative tolerance 1e-13 on both sides, all-spin post-check over spins 41 to 90, bisection brackets 0.0011 to 0.0019 wide. The other 15 points (c = 1.00625, 1.00875, 1.02, 1.0263, 1.04625, 1.08, 1.1, 1.105, 1.11, 1.12, 1.125, 1.13, 1.135, 1.14, 1.15) are stored sampled-window records (functional certificate on the SDP constraints, integer test on the eta-widened bracket, all-spin post-check to spin 90); the re-bisection did not lower them
